headlines.text: Back on this day in 2024, Young Bucks & Okada vs. The Acclaimed vs. The Young Bucks vs. Anthony Bowens vs. Max Caster vs. Darby Allin vs. Mark Briscoe vs. Swerve Strickland vs. Matthew Jackson vs. Nicholas Jackson vs. Kazuchika Okada vs. Adam Page vs. Jack Perry settled things in a Blood And Guts match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 8.49 ? an excellent showing, on an outstanding Blood and Guts '24 show that earned an overall rating of 8.13. The annual Blood and Guts cage brawl saw Team AEW battle The Elite across two rings and a steel cage, with Darby Allin descending from the rafters to complete Team AEW's five-man lineup before they claimed the win.
Back on this day in 2024, Britt Baker was back in action after a long-awaited stretch away after just over 10 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Chris Jericho vs. Minoru Suzuki clashed for the FTW Title in a FTW Rules match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.09. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
